arguments.message: You can change the email that receives invoices. By default it goes to the workspace’s billing contact (usually the person who set up billing). In Settings → Billing → Recipients you can add or replace that address with any email you want – even a shared inbox – and you can add multiple recipients. The change takes effect on the next invoice that’s generated.
